{{Quote|As a child I was a slave on Tatooine. I may have been just another Twi'lek girl, but I was strong enough to escape my abusive owner, bribe a monk to remove my transmitter and stow aboard a tanker to flee this sandy hellpot of a planet. After ten years in a company of Zabrak mercenaries, I've decided to settle the unfinished business of my youth. I'm going to pay a visit to my old owner. I need someone to pay a similar visit to the slavers who ruined my life.|Pura Kotal|<ref name="SWG:PFtS" />}}
'''Pura Kotal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who grew up as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. When she was still a child, she managed to bribe a [[Monk/Legends|monk]] to remove her [[Slave tracking device|tracking device]] and escape the planet aboard a [[Tanker/Legends|tanker]]. She then joined a group of [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and lived with them for years. Ten years after escaping slavery, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Pura Kotal decided to return to Tatooine to take her revenge. There, she hired a group of spacer who attacked and finally killed the [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] who enslaved her. <ref name="SWG:PFtS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pura Kotal was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PFtS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
